messages:
Alex Kim: Quick ping — PR #45678 is ready for canary. This is the routing fallback change that shifts low-priority traffic to cheaper variants. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before we schedule a 1h canary. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/45678 :eyes:
Priya Menon: @Alex thanks — can you paste a short canary plan + rollback criteria here? Also who owns rollback? :thinking_face:
Alex Kim: Canary plan pasted below. Rollback owner: Jorge (in infra) unless runtime requests otherwise. TL;DR: 10% traffic, 1 hour window, auto-fallback on 5xx spike or latency >100ms  p50 increase >20%

Canary plan:
```json
{
  "pr": 45678,
  "window": "1h",
  "traffic_percent": 10,
  "slo_checks": ["5xx_rate>1%","p50_latency_increase>20%"],
  "rollback_action": "re-route-to-previous-model-variant"
}
```

Mina Park: I'll take runtime review. I skimmed the diff — looks fine but need to know KV cache TTL change and whether we expect cold-start token overhead. Can you paste the config snippet for eviction/ttl?
Alex Kim: Good call. Config snippet below. This is the only behavior change that could spike cold tokens.

```yaml
eviction:
  enabled: true
  strategy: lru
  ttl_seconds: 600  # reduced from 1800
  prefetch_threshold: 0.5
```

Mina Park: Reducing TTL to 10m could cause a small bump for long-tail sequences. I'll run a quick perf diff against the canary model locally and report back by EOD. If p50 stays within 10% we should be fine. :+1:
Jorge Alvarez: I'm the rollback owner. Quick question: does this change require any infra config (routing table or NLB) updates? If so we need an ops window.
Alex Kim: No NLB changes. It's purely routing tier logic (orchestrator config). No infra deploys required. Ops window not necessary.
Priya Menon: Security notes — sec-ci-bot, did the automated scan for this PR finish?
sec-ci-bot: Auto-scan complete for PR #45678 — no high severity findings, 2 medium findings (dependency outdated), issue links: https://ci.redwood/scans/45678 (reacts :white_check_mark:)
Priya Menon: I'll do a quick manual read on the medium findings and call it. If nothing surprising, security can LGTM by EOD.
Alex Kim: Thanks everyone. Timeline: if runtime + infra confirm before 16:00 UTC and security OK by EOD, I'll schedule the canary at 17:00 UTC today. Will post the canary start and monitor channel when I flip it.
Mina Park: Running perf now. FYI I'll comment inline in the PR with any small tweak requests.
Jorge Alvarez: I can be on standby at 17:00 for rollback. Ping me in #oncall when you flip.
Priya Menon: Sounds good. Thanks Alex. :thumbsup:
